title: Cauthon Beehive Counter
description: a plugin that has a command for checking bee counts in beehives and nests. Also has a sign monitor for them.
body:
## Overview
Cauthon Beehive Counter is a plugin that allows players to monitor the bee population in beehives and bee nests.

## Commands
/cauthonbeehivecounter: This command allows the player to check the number of bees in the beehive or bee nest they are currently looking at.

## Placing a Sign To Monitor Hives
When a player places a sign on to a beehive or bee nest, the sign updates automatically to show the current bee count.
